objectives: “介紹細胞之生化生理及細胞培養的方法, 著重於觀念的建立與邏輯思考“
content:
“The lecture is updated with the latest research in the field of cell biology, and it provides an exceptional framework for learning cell biology and cell culture.

Introduction of cell and cell culture
Building blocks and polymers
Nucleic Acid
Peptide and Protein
DNA replication and repair
Transcription
Translation
Cell cycle and cell division
Stem cell
Cell physiology- apoptosis
Cell physiology- autophagy
Cell culture techniques“
books: “Molecular Biology of the Cell 7/e 2022, ISBN-13碼:9780815344643, 作者: Alberts“
